include: Primary scholarly work with direct claim-level value for item-side zero-edge cold start, content-based recommendation efficacy, transferable item/sequence representation, target-domain adaptation, or a necessary collaborative sparse-graph control.
Published or accepted by the cutoff, with canonical identity verifiable against a publisher, proceedings, repository of record, or DOI registry.
Adds non-redundant coverage, an audit-core anchor, a counter-evidence role, or a required mechanism boundary.
exclude: Cold-user-only, social-elicitation, dataset-only, domain-specific non-retail, or generic recommendation work without direct L4 claim value.
Redundant direct methods that add lower claim-level value than the retained definition, transfer, counter-evidence, and content-objective set.
Compute-expanding LLM or generative branches that do not close a locked coverage gap.
Secondary snippets, metadata-only pages, and repositories as evidence of original paper content.
eligibility_criteria.application_rule: The same criteria were applied to old and new candidates; authority alone was insufficient without relevance, coverage, and claim-level value.

reason_codes.OUTSIDE_ITEM_SIDE_SCOPE: User-side, social, elicitation, generic cold-start, or side of cold start not separable from the title/metadata screen.
reason_codes.OUTSIDE_REQUIRED_DOMAIN_OR_TASK: Non-retail recommendation/prediction task or dataset-only work outside L4.
reason_codes.TANGENTIAL_SEQUENCE_OR_LONG_TAIL: Sequential, tail, sparse, or representation work without direct strict item-cold or locked transfer-assumption value.
reason_codes.REDUNDANT_LOWER_CLAIM_VALUE: Direct candidate but does not add non-redundant claim coverage beyond the retained set.
reason_codes.COMPUTE_OR_SCOPE_EXPANSION: LLM, diffusion, adversarial, or other branch that expands compute/scope without closing a locked evidence gap.
reason_codes.DUPLICATE_VERSION: Non-canonical or duplicate manifestation of a record already screened.
reason_codes.OWNED_BY_OTHER_LANE: Scholarly dataset or external-validity evidence assigned outside L4.
